digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler, bridge subsystem, ticket store
propositions: Teams running multiple tracker projects against one codebase cannot use the bridge because it is hard-wired to a single project at three points: JiraConfig.project scalar, fetcher JQL pair, and applier CrossProjectTargetError guard.
A shared ticket store between N repos and N tracker projects must own the project set in .bridge_state/projects.json to prevent each repo's fetch subset from being seen as remote deletions.

The tri-state ticket project field (absent=legacy, explicit-empty=never sync, explicit key=sync there) must be seeded by an idempotent ensure unit without event writes to avoid silent skips under lock contention.

Multi-project inbound fetch must iterate the configured project set for base JQL and all three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink maps), with results merged into a shared snapshot and per-query truncation scoped per project.

Outbound mutations must target a ticket's recorded project (create) or verify membership in the configured set (update), with atomic tracker commits combining capability stamp and mapping mutation to prevent observable intermediate state.

Pre-feature stores must resolve every ticket to the recorded legacy default with zero events written, and multi-project stores must carry the multi-project-bridge capability stamp with fail-closed enforcement on older binaries.
